resume: A grant for families with at least 3 children who move around the time of a birth: date conditions, maximum amounts, documents to send and the 6-month deadline.
aQuoiCaSert: The moving grant (prime de déménagement) reimburses your actual moving costs, up to a ceiling, if you have at least 3 children and move during pregnancy or within two years of the youngest child's birth. It is paid in one installment, on proof. If your situation is precarious, an advance based on a quote is possible.
quiEstConcerne: Families with at least 3 dependent children, born or expected.
Who are entitled, for the new home, to the APL (aide personnalisée au logement, personalized housing aid) or the ALF (allocation de logement familiale, family housing allowance).
Separated parent: these conditions are assessed for your own Caf household.
aSavoir: Dates: the move must take place between the 1st day of the calendar month following the end of the 3rd month of pregnancy and the last day of the month before the youngest child's 2nd birthday.

Current ceilings (service-public.gouv.fr, checked on April 1, 2026): €1,147.58 for 3 children, €1,243.21 for 4 children, plus €95.63 per additional child. You are reimbursed for your actual costs within this limit.
Advance if your situation is precarious: 50% to 75% of the quote. The paid invoice must then be provided within 6 months of the move to receive the balance.
The application is made to the Caf (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office), or the MSA for the agricultural scheme, of your new place of residence, within 6 months of the move.
If you are refused, you have 2 months after receiving the decision to appeal by letter to the amicable appeals board (commission de recours amiable).
